content: Hello, I would like to place a delivery order, please.
Welcome to Karachi Kitchen, what can I get started for you?
Could you please tell me what you have available and your prices?
We have chicken biryani for nine hundred rupees, chicken karahi for fourteen hundred, chicken pulao for eight hundred, and raita for one hundred fifty rupees.
Could you tell me what the delivery fee and tax are, and if you have a minimum order?
The delivery fee is one hundred fifty rupees, there is no tax, and we do not have a minimum order.
Could you please make it less spicy if possible?
Sure, we can make it less spicy. What would you like to order?
Could you please tell me if you need my delivery address and phone number now?
Yes, please tell me your address and phone number, and what food you would like.
My address is House 12, Street 4, F-7/2, Islamabad, and my callback number is 0300-0000000. I would like two chicken biryani and one raita, and please make it less spicy if possible.
Got it, two chicken biryani and one raita, less spicy. That is nineteen hundred fifty rupees total including delivery, and it will take forty-five minutes.
